scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.headless.json && node scripts/bake-terrain.mjs && vite build
scripts.test:fast: node scripts/guard-architecture.mjs --quiet && node scripts/test-build.mjs --typecheck && node scripts/test-tier.mjs fast
scripts.test:heavy: scripts/heavy-check.sh --class heavy-suite --machine any -- sh -c 'node scripts/test-build.mjs && node scripts/test-tier.mjs heavy'
scripts.check: npm run test:fast && npm run test:heavy && node scripts/bake-terrain.mjs && vite build
